Final suites assert structure.layers.ffu.visible === false in every view.

implementationBoundary.constraint: 所有 3D 效果必须由 Babylon Lite 原生能力或 WebGPU 公开 API 实现
implementationBoundary.constraintTranslation: All 3D effects must be implemented with Babylon Lite native capabilities or public WebGPU APIs.
implementationBoundary.lighting: Official Lite directional/hemispheric/point/spot lights + official MaterialPlugin public WGSL slots compiled into the native Lite PBR pipeline (enableMaterialPlugins); source local lights ride the material UBO. No custom render pass, no private Lite API, no regex WGSL rewriter, no forked Lite shader.
implementationBoundary.shadows: Native createCsmDirectionalShadowGenerator + enableCsmStaticCache + setShadowTaskCasterMeshes + setShadowGeneratorEnabled + registerSceneWithShadowSupport. No hand-written depth pass or GPUTexture.
implementationBoundary.facilityGeometry: Native createMeshFromData/createBox/createCylinder/createPlane, thin instances and facing-billboard system; native ShaderMaterial (WGSL) for the air-shower jets. Canvas2D only generates source textures/label sprites, not 3D rendering.
